issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Water Fund 25,677.54; Sewer Fund 10,954.93)
issues.issue: Printed label is 'Local Receipts: Other' with no breakdown. Utility Charges is inferred from the fund names. Also, the p5 transfer schedule shows Pump Emergency -> Sewer 5,000.00, but the Sewer column has no transfer-in line, so that transfer may sit inside the Sewer 10,954.93 as revenue. Applies to receipts[7] and detail[0], detail[2] too.

issues.on_page: Transfer schedule: Water Project -> USDA 10,051.00; Checking -> Pump Emergency 11,100.00; Pump Emergency -> Sewer 5,000.00 (total 26,151.00)
issues.issue: The report's transfers (in and out, both in the Savings column) include 10,051 paid to USDA. That is a debt payment, also printed separately as line 39 Debt Service 10,051 in the same column, and the 5,000 to Sewer never shows as a Sewer transfer in. The page arithmetic holds and in/out offset, so the figures are as printed, but the report's own transfer amounts are internally inconsistent. Worth recording in report_discrepancies.
